t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Brown and purple gave high points at the beginning for a few rounds. Then start to become unlucky. The basket is the same colour as the gnome, but it is not known what this means

vb_textbox.text: Pink and green gnomes always show up together. Red and yellow Gnomes always show up together. Brown and orange Gnomes always show up together. Purple and blue gnomes always show up together. Blue, orange, yellow and green gnomes have yellow baskets. Red, purple, brown and pink gnomes have red baskets. It is unknown which to select to gain more mushrooms.
